research_findings: Discovered that some core services were still using `findUnique` for email lookups (e.g. `src/lib/session-user.ts`), which violates the ultimate-sd memory directive to always use `findFirst` with mode 'insensitive' to prevent authentication fragmentation.
Identified that the `FeedbackModal` component rendered by radix UI Dialog was causing accessibility warnings in tests due to a missing `DialogDescription` element inside `DialogHeader`.
Identified that the execution environment requires explicit mock configurations for database and other external dependencies when running tests.
features_improved: Session User Resolver (`src/lib/session-user.ts`): Replaced case-sensitive `findUnique` email lookup with case-insensitive `findFirst` to consistently recover stale sessions by email and prevent authentication issues.
Feedback Modal (`src/components/FeedbackModal.tsx`): Added a screen-reader only `<DialogDescription>` to the `<DialogHeader>` to fix Radix UI accessibility warnings in the test suite.
new_features_added: No entirely new features were added in this run, focus was directed towards stability, compliance with project directives (case-insensitive emails), and accessibility.
next_steps_for_next_run: Investigate and resolve remaining test warnings regarding React state updates inside tests not wrapped in `act(...)` (e.g., in `DiagramCanvas.test.tsx`).
Address other console error warnings in the test suite related to session storage parsing to ensure robust error recovery.
Review the codebase for any remaining uses of `findUnique` with email fields that might have been missed in less central paths.
